heading: The Brno Celebration Tram (Šalina)
intro: At 16:30, straight after the defense, we board a private historic party tram and celebrate while rolling through Brno — until it drops us off for dinner at 18:30. Yes, really.

about.label: Onboard bar
about.value: Three taps, two fridges, coffee machine — drinks flowing the whole way

about.label: Sound & screens
about.value: Bluetooth sound system, screens, party lights, WiFi, and yes — a toilet

details.label: Drop-off
details.value: 18:30 — the tram drops us off for dinner

details.label: Route
details.value: A loop through Brno on a private tram, ending near the dinner venue. [TBC]

note: Two hours of Brno rolling past the window with a bar on board. Meeting point still to be confirmed — everything else is locked in.
